name: POST /api/empi/merges - reversible merge of two persons
description: Performs a direct reversible merge of two person records (steward/ops path, bypassing the approval queue). surviving_person_id and merged_person_id are both required; link_id optionally ties the merge back to the candidate link that motivated it and reason is free text. decided_by is taken from the JWT persona, never the body. Edge cases: either person id missing -> 400; a non-existent person id, or merging a record into itself, is not guarded at the route and fails inside mergeRecords ('empi: merge failed' or an FK error) as a 500 InternalError; the merge is reversible only through the unmerge endpoint; repeating the same merge creates a second merge row, so the endpoint is not idempotent.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
the merge insert returns no row — unknown person ids, a self-merge, or an FK/constraint violation

payload.reason: Duplicate patient records confirmed by steward
